questions.question: Apply the functions of trade unions to explain how the unions could have effectively represented workers.
questions.solution_html:
• Ans: Functions of Trade Unions (Application):
  • ▪ Represent workers in collective bargaining for better wages and conditions
  • ▪ Protect workers’ rights and ensure fair treatment
  • ▪ Act as a link between workers and management to resolve disputes
  • ▪ Promote worker welfare and job security
  • If properly coordinated, unions could have negotiated effectively and avoided
  • disputes.

questions.question: a. Case Study 1: Industrial Relations at Silverline Plastics Ltd. CO1, CO2, CO3, CO4 (An) Background: Silverline Plastics Ltd. is a medium -sized manufacturing unit employing around 280 workers. Recently, the management introduced higher production targets and extended working hours to meet market demand. These changes were implemented without prior consultation with employees or the recognised trade union. Workers raised concerns regarding increased workload, inadequate safety measures, and delay in wage revision. Several grievances submitted by the union were not addressed in time. As a result, employees resorted to a one-day strike, which disrupted production and caused financial loss to the company. Although a grievance redressal committee and Works Committee exist as per statutory provisions, they function poorly. Workers’ participation in management i s minimal, and welfare facilities such as canteen and safety equipment are inadequate, leading to low morale and strained industrial relations.
